title: Invertibility of the canonical derived pullback lift
statement: Let the derived categories of O_X-modules of all schemes X [def-pc-derived-category] be chosen. For each scheme morphism f [def-pc-scheme], suppose the recorded tensor pullback [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] is additive and has a counit ε_f from Qh ⋙ Lf* to its homotopy functor followed by Qh, exhibiting derivedPullback f [def-pc-derived-pullback] as a left derived functor. Suppose ε_f is invertible on every K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex]. For any f:X→Y and g:Y→Z, the left-derived lift into L(f≫g)* of the composite counits ε_g and ε_f followed by the homotopy image of the adjunction conjugate of pushforwardComp f g is an isomorphism. The adjunctions in this conjugate are precisely Classical.choose of exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction for f, g and f≫g.

proof.text: Termwise tensor pullback of a scheme complex is definitionally equal to tensorPullbackComplex in the ringed-space preservation theorem. Apply isKFlat_pullback to obtain K-flatness of g*P.

For K-flat P, ε_g at P, ε_f at g*P, and ε_(f≫g) at P are isomorphisms. The underived conjugate comparison is an isomorphism, so the composite counit β at P is invertible. Apply leftDerived_fac_app and cancel ε_(f≫g) to show the lift at Qh(P) is invertible.

For any complex G, choose a K-flat resolution P→G. Its homotopy quotient is a quasi-isomorphism and Qh inverts it. Naturality transports invertibility from Qh(P) to Qh(G). Qh is essentially surjective, so every component is invertible; NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app proves the result.

theorem isIso_derivedPullbackCompositionLift
    [d : ∀ X : Scheme.{u₁}, HasDerivedCategory.{w₁}
      (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (a : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).Additive)
      (ε : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y),
        DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
            DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))
      (hL : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y),
        (derivedPullback f).IsLeftDerivedFunctor (ε f)
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hK : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
      (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) P →
        IsIso ((ε f).app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)))
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    IsIso ((derivedPullback (f ≫ g)).leftDerivedLift (ε (f ≫ g))
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
              (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
            (derivedPullback g ⋙ derivedPullback f)
            ((Functor.associator DerivedCategory.Qh (derivedPullback g)
                (derivedPullback f)).inv ≫
              Functor.whiskerRight (ε g) (derivedPullback f) ≫
              (Functor.associator _ DerivedCategory.Qh (derivedPullback f)).hom ≫
              Functor.whiskerLeft _ (ε f) ≫
              (Functor.associator _ _
                (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))).inv ≫
              Functor.whiskerRight
                (Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso
                  ((conjugateIsoEquiv
                    (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (f ≫ g)))
                    ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).comp
                      (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)))).symm
                    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).symm)
                  (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom
                (DerivedCategory.Qh
                (C := SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))))
